purpose: Local evidence-generation and agent-result validation workflow for agentic view classification, with DICOM metadata extraction, rendered media evidence, guideline summaries, Codex specialist task prompts, and preserved PWD/CWD spectral extraction.
input_contract: A de-identified echo case folder containing DICOM US/SR/PR objects and sidecar files.
output_contract: runs/agentic_view_classifier_validation/<case_id> JSON artifacts plus derived local media and spectral trace artifacts.
validation_scope: Focused unit tests and local A1-A5 validation workflow; no clinical validation claimed.
limitations: Python evidence tools do not choose view, modality, or zoom status; Codex specialist agents author classification records.
PWD sample-site interpretation is not converted to severity without explicit site evidence.
PHI-risk DICOM tag values and private values are redacted from JSON outputs.
Guideline summaries are local agent-usable extracts and do not replace full guideline review.
